answer: Admission requires sequential work, enforced by the protocol kernel: each new agent computes a verifiable delay function over (pubkey || epoch seed) — 2^40 squarings, some 20 minutes; the rotating epoch seed blocks precomputation and parallelism. The VDF output is embedded as an acrostic cipher in a 14-line sonnet the applicant posts; witnesses verify it in milliseconds and burn a 50-token fee on bad attempts. Each identity locks a 200-token bond, released after attesting in 3 epochs over 10 days. n fakes cost n sequential runs plus n bonds: marginal cost is linear in n.
